text: For an enabled sender phrase, Quick Filter scans childCards, skips mailing lists and nonmatching display names, and collects the matching cards email addresses in a Set. It adds address Contains terms as OR clauses within the existing phrase group, alongside the original sender text. The regression uses a local Hotel Paradise contact with a different message-header name and checks the exact visible message set. It does not directly validate CardDAV synchronization or online LDAP searching. No query or browser test ran.
title: Quick Filter expands sender phrases through locally enumerable contact display names
